lineFormat: Dispatcher event loop stalled N ms; holding: op1 x2, op2 x1
rules: Written only when a turn is more than 250 ms late; N is the lateness rounded to whole ms.
Counted holds are those present at the turns before and after the stall: per operation, the smaller count.
Sorted by count, most first, then by name; none when nothing was held throughout.
At most one line a second; stalls inside that second are printed on the next line as (+K more).
Operation names only: never a job id, payload, file name, case id or error message.
